notes: The seasonal job has one name everywhere: Winterization. Route, Home, reminders, and new invoice lines now say Winterization, including the built-in quick line. Your saved invoices keep their wording.
Fill Gaps now tells you why nothing moved. If there are open slots but your later stops were placed by hand or set to a time, it says so instead of saying every day is full.
Undo after Re-Optimize now says Re-Optimize Undone.
